cohort: The study included 70 nulliparous pregnant women who were randomly assigned to either a Hatha Yoga group or a control group receiving routine prenatal care.
finding: Yoga intervention significantly reduced induction of labor, episiotomy rupture, duration of labor, and positively affected normal birth weight and appropriate gestational age at delivery, while also showing significant differences in infant Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Yoga can reduce the risk of cesarean section (CS) and preterm delivery.
